title: net_watch::latest() re-probes the routing table on the UI thread on every poll while the route reads offline
trigger: Disconnect the network (or have no route to Telegram) and leave Quill open; the screen poll and each background account poll call poll_ticks(.., net_watch::latest()) every pump
effect: Each pump runs route_now(): two UDP bind/connect calls plus a netlink socket (Linux), SCDynamicStore lookups (macOS) or GetBestRoute2 (Windows), all under the tracker mutex that the watcher thread also needs; wasted work and possible UI stalls while offline, multiplied by the number of background accounts
fix: Let the watcher thread own the probe and publish a NetworkState (epoch, available) in an atomic; latest() only reads it, with a rate-limited re-probe owned by the watcher while offline.

title: Neighbour resolution is tracked in three places kept in step by hand
trigger: A gateway whose link-layer address is not yet resolved: Tracker::resolving (gateways asked), link::Resolving v4/v6 AtomicBools (resolve thread in flight) and Path::carried/settled (hardware carried over from the previous route)
effect: No bug today; a failed link::resolve (UDP bind failure) is never retried because Tracker::resolving already names the gateway, and a resolve thread that never returns holds its IP version flag forever
fix: One per-gateway enum Neighbour { Unasked, Asking{since}, Resolved(mac), GaveUp } owned by Tracker, replacing the flags.

title: Coalesce is a dirty + running pair of atomics that must change together
trigger: Windows network change delivers dozens of callbacks on system threads
effect: Correct today (the loop re-checks dirty after clearing running); the stage is encoded by two bools instead of Idle/Running/RunningDirty
fix: A single AtomicU8 with states Idle, Running, RunningDirty and compare_exchange transitions.

title: StageFacts mirrors request liveness as bools next to the NewChatStage enum
trigger: New Group/Channel flow: create_pending, type_pending, type_failed and outcome are derived from Session.requests and info_edit_errors on each draw and combined with NewChatStage by view()
effect: Stage and facts can disagree (Creating with no outcome and no live request shows the back step unbusy; Type{saving:Some} with a request that vanished goes straight to Subscribers as if the save succeeded)
fix: Put the request state in the stage: Creating{request, state: Fetch<ChatId>} and Type{saving: Saving{requests, state: InFlight|Failed(reason)|Done}} updated by the answer, instead of re-deriving it from the session.

title: NewChatStage::Type.saving: Option<Vec<RequestId>> is a 'save attempted' flag cleared by hand
trigger: Type step: Save sends requests (saving=Some), a refusal is read from groups.info_edit_errors[chat] (keyed by chat, field Username, not by request); typing in the link field sets saving=None via new_chat_link_edited
effect: A refusal from a save that is not the one in flight is shown for the current one, and a save whose requests all vanished without an answer moves on to Subscribers as if it succeeded
fix: Type{chat, save: TypeSave} with TypeSave::{Editing, Saving(requests), Refused(reason)}; match the refusal by request id.

title: A create guarded by purpose, not by dialog: closing the dialog mid-create leaves a silent no-op Create and an unexpected chat open
trigger: New group: fill name and members, press Create, close the dialog before TDLib answers, reopen New Group and press Create again
effect: create_new_chat returns Ok(None) while the first request is out and the UI ignores it (button does nothing); when the first answer arrives run_new_chat_created calls select_chat for the group although its dialog is gone; NewChatState.creations entries are never removed
fix: Key the in-flight create to the dialog (a Creating stage the closing dialog cancels or hands to a toast) and drop the creations entry when its answer is applied.

title: Widget crash streak lives in a counter beside Lifecycle
effect: Whether a Stopped widget restarts depends on WidgetEntry::crashes (reset in widgets_ui.rs at content change and first frame, bumped on stop) and on runtime.is_none() in widget_bubble.rs, not on the Lifecycle value alone
fix: Lifecycle::Stopped{reason, streak: u8} and Lifecycle::GaveUp{reason}, so the streak resets when the variant changes.

title: Signal handler stage is IN_HANDLER + REPORT_DONE + INSTALLED atomics
trigger: A fault in one thread while another faults
effect: Works today (first thread writes, others wait up to 2 s); stage is three separate bools
fix: One AtomicU8 with Idle, Reporting, Reported.

title: Active crash report file is shared by every running instance of Quill
trigger: Start a second Quill process on the same logs folder (a second profile run or a second launch) while the first runs, then quit the second cleanly
effect: install() truncates native-crash-active.txt and the second instance's clean quit (discard_active) removes it, so a later crash of the first instance leaves a closed-fd report nobody finds; the first instance's start-up promote_previous can also file the second's report
fix: Name the active file by pid (native-crash-active-<pid>.txt) and promote only files whose pid is dead.

title: Background unread is a process-global atomic written by the UI at several call sites
trigger: Account switch, retire_live_to_background, take_background_live, poll, stop_background_clients each call publish_background_unread
effect: A path that changes background clients without calling publish_background_unread leaves the tray, dock badge and window title with the old other-accounts count (also read without an owner key by window_chrome.rs)
fix: Derive the badge from BackgroundAccounts::total_unread when drawing, or make the clients list the single writer through a setter that publishes.

title: Notification bursts coalesce by chat only, so forum topics merge
trigger: A forum supergroup gets a message in topic A then one in topic B before the queue drains
effect: One toast reading 'N new messages'; the inline reply target message_id is the newest message, in topic B, and the first topic's title/body is lost
fix: Key the queue by (chat, topic) using the ChatMessage/topic owner key.
